I thought it was just a proposal, but it actually passed 🤯

France will charge €0.055 per GB on all internet traffic! https://t.co/mfiiPnttK2
posts.text_zh:
我还以为这只是个提案，没想到真的通过了 🤯

法国将对所有互联网流量按每 GB 收取 €0.055！https://t.co/mfiiPnttK2
posts.quoted_text:
🔴 🇫🇷 ALERTE INFO - DU JAMAIS VU: UNE TAXE SUR CHAQUE GIGAOCTET INTERNET VOTÉE À L’ASSEMBLÉE

Les députés ont adopté un amendement prévoyant de taxer les producteurs de données numériques à hauteur de 5,5 centimes par Go transmis.

💰 Objectif affiché : jusqu’à 10 milliards d’euros par an.

Netflix, YouTube, cloud, jeux dématérialisés… les grands services numériques pourraient être concernés, avec un risque de répercussion sur les prix pour les consommateurs.

📌 Source : Assemblée nationale

#France #Budget2027
posts.quoted_text_zh: 引用：法国议会通过按每 GB 征 5.5 欧分数据税的修正案，目标最高约 100 亿欧元/年，可能波及 Netflix、YouTube、云服务等。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
Some people say they don't believe these numbers

So calculate it for yourself:

~115 deaths ÷ ~35M high speed train trips
=
1 in 300,000 is the statistical odds of death per trip in a Spanish high speed train this year

You can then argue "why do you cherry pick only this year", well because it happened this year! It's new information and you have 2 highly similar fatal accidents happening in one year meaning the probability that's random is almost zero

It's like saying after the 737 Max crashes that killed 346 people in 2018/2019

"That's just a random statistical oddity, I'll board the next one immediately"

Of course you wouldn't

What you'd do is board none at all until it's fully investigated why they crashed and the cause is solved, like the FAA did exactly by grounding them

To all the Spanish nationalist keyboard warriors attacking me instead of their government:

Pivot your energy to prosecuting the people responsible for killing 100+ innocent people this year instead of shooting the messenger!
posts.text_zh:
有人说他们不相信这些数字

那你自己算一下：

约 115 人死亡 ÷ 约 3500 万次高铁出行
=
今年西班牙高铁每次出行的死亡统计概率是 30 万分之一

你可以说「为什么只挑这一年」，因为就是今年发生的！这是新信息，一年里发生两起高度相似的致命事故，纯属随机的概率几乎为零

这就像 2018/2019 年 737 Max 坠机造成 346 人死亡之后还说

「这只是随机统计巧合，我马上再上下一班」

你当然不会

你会一班都不上，直到彻底查清坠毁原因并解决，就像 FAA 通过停飞所做的那样

致所有攻击我而不是攻击政府的西班牙民族主义键盘侠：

把精力转到追究今年害死 100+ 无辜者的责任人身上，而不是迁怒报信人！

posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
Strange feeling: finding out an album you love was made with AI music models (Suno, Udio, Lyria) and with no people playing instruments.

I play music. I listened for months and had no idea.

The top 1% of AI music is getting scary good. https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
posts.text_zh:
奇怪的感觉：发现自己喜欢的一张专辑是用 AI 音乐模型（Suno、Udio、Lyria）做的，没有真人演奏乐器。

我自己也玩音乐。听了好几个月完全没听出来。

AI 音乐顶尖的那 1% 已经好到吓人了。https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
